newsitem.title: USA: PEPCO again shuts 341 MW Md. coal unit.
newsitem.headline: PEPCO again shuts 341 MW Md. coal unit.

text.p: Potomac Electric Power Co's (PEPCO) 341 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at its Chalk Point generating complex in Aquasco, Md., was shut Friday after being returned to service briefly the same day, the company said.

The unit was on line 0300 EDT/0700 GMT, but was taken out of service a little after 0700/1100 when a problem with a safety valve developed, said a company spokesman, adding Chalk Point unit 1 was expected to startup again over the weekend.
The coal-fired unit was originally shut less than a week ago to correct a boiler tube leak.
PEPCO is the the operator and owner of the Chalk Point facility, which has four units and installed capacity just over 2,000 MW.
Potomac Electric Power is headquartered in Washington DC.
